versions.content: DdsCpConsumedServiceInstance deployment The deploy- ment of a DdsCpConsumedServiceInstance to an EcuInstance is achieved via reference localUnicastAddress . The ApplicationEndpoint referenced by each of them defines the corresponding UDP port, while the NetworkEndpoint referenced by the ApplicationEndpoint specifies the IP address at which the Service consumer is located. This Endpoint information is transported via the DDS Participant Discovery protocol. With the SocketAddress . connector reference the deployment to an EcuInstance is achieved.
